title: COUNTERPOINT.
metaDescription: Two Asher Cut diamonds in deliberate counterpoint — 16.48 ctw center stones. Bez Ambar, Los Angeles.
copy: Two Asher Cut diamonds in deliberate counterpoint. The form's characteristic internal refraction — broad table, parallel facets — catches light as depth rather than flash. Set as a pair, each stone responds independently to movement, to angle, to light. Same cut, contrasting weight. One voice answering the other.
